onboarding.title: Get started with Kumo
onboarding.subtitle: Kumo is free — set up the basics in a few minutes
onboarding.step1_desc: Log a purchase, a bill, or anything you spent.
onboarding.step2_desc: Add contacts with WhatsApp or enable push. Receipt scanning is an optional paid add-on.
onboarding.step3_desc: Doctor appointments, birthdays, whatever. We'll let you know when they're close.
onboarding.step4_desc: We'll guide you to paste the link in Google Calendar (the field always starts empty).
onboarding.skipping: Done — you can revisit this checklist from Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Contacts, currency, timezone, theme and notification preferences.
settings.whatsapp_desc: Your number stays here for compatibility. To manage who gets notified, use the Contacts section above.
settings.calendar_feed_desc: Subscribe your reminders and due dates to Google Calendar (read-only). Google can't auto-fill the URL — we'll guide you step by step.
settings.calendar_feed_step1: Tap Connect and copy the link.
settings.calendar_feed_step2: Open Google Calendar and paste the link in the URL field (it's always empty at first).
settings.calendar_feed_step3: Tap Add calendar. Google syncs every few hours.
settings.calendar_feed_guide_intro: Google always shows an empty URL field — that's normal. You need to paste the link yourself.
settings.calendar_feed_guide_link_label: Your Kumo link (copied if we could)
settings.calendar_feed_guide_step1: Copy the link above (or select it and Cmd+C / Ctrl+C).
settings.calendar_feed_guide_step2: Tap Open Google Calendar — it opens in a new tab.
settings.calendar_feed_guide_step3: In the empty field, paste with Cmd+V (Mac) or Ctrl+V (Windows) and confirm.
settings.calendar_feed_guide_paste_hint: If the field is empty in Google, that's not a bug: Google doesn't allow pre-filled URLs for security.
settings.calendar_feed_guide_copied: Link copied — now paste it in Google Calendar
settings.calendar_feed_toast_copied: Link copied — paste it in Google Calendar
settings.calendar_feed_toast_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Show the link manually.
settings.calendar_feed_share_text: Kumo calendar link (reminders and due dates)
settings.calendar_feed_banner_title: Want due dates in Google Calendar?
settings.calendar_feed_banner_desc: We'll show you the link and how to paste it in Google Calendar.
settings.calendar_feed_ios_hint: iPhone/iPad: Settings → Calendar → Accounts → Add Subscription.
settings.calendar_feed_note: This link is private — don't share it. Includes reminders and expenses with due dates.
settings.calendar_feed_rotate_desc: If you shared the link by mistake, regenerate it. The old one will stop working in Google Calendar.
settings.calendar_feed_rotate_confirm_desc: The current link will stop syncing. You'll need to add the new one in Google Calendar again.
settings.calendar_feed_rotate_toast: Link regenerated — copy the new one and update Google Calendar
settings.whatsapp_pending_desc: WhatsApp alerts may take a while to activate. In the meantime, enable push notifications below so you don't miss due dates.
settings.onboarding_reopen_desc: See the dashboard checklist again: first expense, contacts, reminder, and Google Calendar.
settings.onboarding_reopen_toast: Guide reopened — head to the dashboard
settings.notify_expenses: Notify me about upcoming due dates
settings.notify_reminders: Notify me about reminders and birthdays
settings.appearance_desc: Light theme with pastel clouds or dark theme with starry sky.

landing.hero_desc: Log expenses in seconds, schedule due dates, get WhatsApp alerts, and never forget a birthday or rent payment again.
landing.hero_fineprint: No credit card. No install. Privacy by design.
landing.features_title: Everything you need to stay in control
landing.feature_expenses_desc: Log an expense in 5 seconds. Filter by month, year, category or amount. 8 currencies with live conversion.
landing.feature_ocr_desc: Snap a photo of your receipt and AI extracts amount, merchant, date and category. You just confirm.
landing.feature_wa_desc: Automatic alerts before every due date, medical appointment or birthday. For you or your family.
landing.feature_reminders_desc: Medical appointments, birthdays, whatever you need. With configurable lead time.
landing.feature_metrics_desc: How much, on what, when. Charts by category, time evolution and month-over-month comparisons.
landing.feature_shopping_desc: Multiple lists (grocery, pharmacy). Tick items while you shop. Clear with one click.
landing.step1_title: Sign in with Google or email
landing.step1_desc: One click with Google or a magic link to your inbox. No passwords or long forms.
landing.step2_desc: With the camera, by typing, or from a past receipt. Default categories included.
landing.step3_desc: Add your number and the ones you want. We'll alert you before every due date.
landing.final_cta_desc: Takes less time to start than to set up a spreadsheet.

split.page_subtitle: Quickly calculate what each person owes and send it via WhatsApp or save it as a workspace expense.
split.scan_pro_required: Receipt scanning is paid. Tap to see pricing.
split.participants_placeholder: Name and press Enter (e.g. John, Mary)
split.participants_hint: You can type any name or pick one of your contacts.
split.add_person: Add person and press Enter (John, Mary...)
split.mode_equal_hint: Splits the total in equal parts among the participants.
split.mode_percentage_hint: Each person contributes a percentage (must add up to 100%).
split.mode_fixed_hint: Each person contributes a fixed amount (must add up to the total).
split.mode_items_hint: Add each item with its price and tap who consumed it.
split.mode_choose: Pick how you want to split the expense.

split.items_how_to_body: Add each dish/drink with its price and tap the chips of who consumed it. If John ate a $30 burger by himself, he pays $30; if he shares it with Mary, it's $15 each.
split.items_empty: No items yet. Tap "Add item" below.
split.save_disabled_sum: The sum must match the total to save
split.save_disabled_sum_no_match: The sum doesn't match the total
split.sum_mismatch: The sum doesn't match the total
split.participants_tap_hint: Tap a chip to add · ✕ to remove
split.balances_empty_desc: See who owes you and who you owe in this workspace. When you add an expense with "Split" in Expenses, balances are calculated here automatically. You can then record payments when they're settled.
split.balances_page_subtitle: Who owes whom based on shared expenses.
split.balances_empty_settled: All settled. When you split an expense between contacts, balances will appear here.
